metadata.title: Black CEO Leadership & Risk-Adjusted Equity Performance (2000–2026)

Black_CEO_Net.gp_wealth: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Starting with $10,000 in Jan 2000, holding an equal-weighted basket of publicly traded companies led by Black CEOs grew to $262,323 vs. $80,117 for SPY across 6,767 sessions. Peak-to-trough drops were deeper (-70.4% vs. -55.2%), with volatility driven by upside rallies.
Black_CEO_Net.memb_breadth: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Left tracks active Black CEO companies over time (growing from 4 in 2000 to 17 active today). Right breaks down all 40 CEO tenures by sector—led by Healthcare, Financial Services, and Consumer/Tech. Click any CEO row to inspect fundamentals & sources. Top active tenure leader is Alex Karp (PLTR, +1712.3%).
Black_CEO_Net.ecst_macro: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Honest attribution across six cycles: BCEOS outperformed SPY by +50.8% in the 2000–2002 Dot-Com Crash (0.62x downside capture) and +36.2% in the 2023–2026 AI & High-Rate era (0.79x downside capture), while swinging harder during the 2008 GFC and 2022–2023 rate-hike tightening.
Black_CEO_Net.vol_garch: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Pre-2010, holding only 4–7 stocks meant volatility spikes lingered for months. Expanding to 17 active firms cut shock half-life by 95% down to 7.0 trading days, and a causal 20% vol-target overlay trims max drawdown by nearly 20 percentage points.
Black_CEO_Net.alph_factors: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Even after stripping out market beta, small-cap tilt (SMB), and value tilt (HML), annualized FF5 alpha exceeds +10% (p < 0.01), beating 97.6% of 10,000 random S&P cohorts with OOS R² ≈ 0%.

Convex_Quality_Net.gp_wealth: PLAIN ENGLISH (2026-11-27 — CONVEX-QUALITY QP): Tilting toward lower-volatility firms (35% position cap) grew $10,000 into $114,364 vs. $80,117 for SPY while cutting max drawdown from -70.4% to -71.9%.
Convex_Quality_Net.memb_breadth: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Across 17 active issuers (out of 40 historical tenures), Convex-Quality QP allocates higher weight to steady compounders across Healthcare, Financials, and Industrials. Top active tenure leader is Alex Karp (PLTR, +1712.3%).
Convex_Quality_Net.ecst_macro: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Under Convex-Quality weighting, quality tilts cushion drawdowns during 2022–2023 rate hikes and recessions while keeping upside participation during bull expansions.
Convex_Quality_Net.vol_garch: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Pairing Convex-Quality QP with a 20% GARCH volatility target aligns portfolio risk with SPY (~19.9% annualized vol).
Convex_Quality_Net.alph_factors: PLAIN ENGLISH (AS OF 2026-11-27 CLOSE): Quality tilts shift loadings toward profitable firms (positive RMW) while beating 10,000 randomized S&P cohorts.
